{{Top|leg}}
A '''modular circuit matrix''', also referred to as a '''skill matrix''',<ref name="CFTD">''[[Cynabar's Fantastic Technology: Droids]]''</ref> or '''Skill Module''', was a swappable piece of [[Droid/Legends|droid]] programming. The matrices held only one skill at a time and were cheap and easy to install. The matrices could be used to modify a droid's knowledge and skill base. [[SE4 servant droid]]s and [[MSE-6 series repair droid/Legends|MSE-6 series repair droids]] were equipped to use the matrices. For SE4 servant droids, the matrix could be slotted into a insertion slot on the unit's chest. These matrixes allowed the droid to absorb specific knowledge on subjects such as local cuisines and maintenance schedules designed to look after household estates.<ref name="EGTD">''[[The Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref> MSE-6 droids were installed with a single matrix; each matrix was programmed with a single skill, such as the repair of a specific system,<ref name="CFTD" /> janitorial cleanup, security protocols, and basic [[Computer/Legends|computer]] programming.<ref name="EGTD" /> MSE-6s could perform one task, then have the circuit matrix switched out to then perform a different task.<ref name="CFTD" />
